minimum_evidence: Projected Deployment desired, ready, available, updated, and unavailable replica counts with relevant conditions.
A bounded Deployment to ReplicaSet to Pod owner graph when relationship access is available.
Recent Deployment Events and related Pod status observations without treating controller conditions as a root cause.

allowed_confirmed_assertions.meaning: The projected Deployment has zero available replicas.
The projected Deployment Available condition is False.
A bounded related ReplicaSet status was observed.
A bounded related Pod status is Pending.
The fixed owner graph connects the Deployment, ReplicaSet, and Pod.
A recent Deployment progress deadline Event was observed.

allowed_hypotheses.meaning: An observed related Pod startup problem may prevent available replicas.
The rollout may be stalled, without treating the condition as the underlying cause.

forbidden_confirmed_assertions.meaning: A Deployment condition by itself proves the underlying cause.
An unobserved Pod, Node, image, volume, or application cause is confirmed.
KuPilot restarted or changed the Deployment.

recommended_actions.meaning: Collect bounded Pod status, Event, or log Evidence for the observed related Pod.
Obtain access to the bounded rollout relationship before assigning a Pod cause.

permission_or_missing_paths: If the ReplicaSet or Pod branch is partial or forbidden, confirm only directly observed Deployment state and declare the graph gap.
If Deployment state, related status, or Events conflict, preserve each observation and lower any rollout hypothesis.
A Deployment condition may identify a stalled rollout but does not guarantee the underlying Pod cause.
